note: Bureau of Reclamation recreation area on Lake Elwell (Tiber Reservoir), ~13 mi SW of Chester below Tiber Dam on the Marias River; tent and trailer sites with picnic tables and fire rings, and a boat launch. --Claude
summary: Reclamation-managed (Lake Elwell, Chester office); not on recreation.gov. Cleared derived hookups none, 35-ft max, vault toilets and potable water (all rest on aggregators). Booking (FCFS, 14-day limit) left as recorded: not on recreation.gov, otherwise unconfirmed. Note trimmed.
flags: No agency page for this campground: Reclamation's only page is the reservoir-wide Lake Elwell facilities table (https://www.usbr.gov/gp/recreation/lerrec.html), which does not name Sanford Park; site sizes, toilets, water and RV suitability are known only from aggregators (Ultimate Montana, Visit Montana, Campendium).
